notes.title: Hotfix | Keep Calm and Wobble On
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’re back again for ANOTHER hotfix update. Didn’t think you’d see us back so soon huh?!

We’ve been loving the amount of love and feedback the closed beta has gotten in the last week, and our devs are continuing to work hard to fix some of the small issues a lot of you have been running into! We’re back for some smaller bugs to help smooth out your experience even more!

If you run into any other bugs that aren’t noted in our Known Issues thread, or mentioned in any of our hotfixes, you can go to support.southfieldgame.com to raise a ticket, which will go straight to our team. We also have a bug reporting forum in our community Discord. We’re a small team, so we may not be able to reply to every report, but we’ll keep you updated about any fixes!

🌱Full patch notes:

 Bud now moves faster in Ball Mode
 Bud can now move easier in the air whilst in Ball Mode
 Bud is now slightly heftier in Ball Mode
 Fixed default settings confirmation screen popping up when scrolling through tabs in the menu
 Fixed crops not being placed into a seeder when holding down the Y/ Triangle button (controller only)
 Fixed Lop Hops being too shy. They are now above ground as intended!
 Fixed some crops decaying in the wild
 Fixed shiny crops not growing on the correct structure. Some shiny plants have shiny leaves now too!
 Fixed the Quest Complete screen not going away once the quest is completed
 Fixed the 'Something Strange' quest not being pinned after finishing the tutorial
 Fixed a UI issue with closing and reopening the quest menu after pinning a quest
 Fixed being able to accept multiple of the same quest at the notice board
 Fixed the Shipping Bin being wrongly mislabelled as the Storage Chest

notes.title: Hotfix | More Smoosh, No Problem
notes.notes:
Hey buds, another hotfix whaaaat!

You might have seen we pushed a hotfix yesterday, where we added more poop to the game to resolve a hotfix. This time we’re here to stop the ground eating all your items, because that’s very rude tbh.

As usual, if you need to get in touch with us to report a bug not currently on our Known Issues thread, or mentioned in the fixes below, you can visit support.southfieldgame.com to raise a ticket. We also have a dedicated bug reporting forum in our community Discord.

Please be mindful that we are a small team and may not be able to respond to every report, but we’ll keep you posted on any fixes.

Full patch notes:

 Fixed an issue where the game was not saving tutorial progress when reloading*
 Improvements to performance (less stuttering)
 The ground should no longer eat your items
 I kid you not, we’ve added even more poop (Smoosh)
 We’ve also added more Ooze (dropped from Ruffians, and purchasable)
 Missing tooltips for certain items in Vendors now show properly
 Fixed sliders in settings menu stopping player apply new settings
 Reduced popping issues
 Fixed the quest board breaking your quest flow
 World will reset more often meaning more resources
 More coal available around starting area*
 More Boingers will appear around starting area*
 Boingers will now grow faster (more Boingers for you)
 Eat those Boingers, get more stamina (more energy, more footwork)
 You no longer get given a singular pebble as a reward for the watering can quest (you get nothing, good day sir)

*applicable only to new save files

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959940/

notes.title: Hotfix | Getting Smoosh Done
notes.notes:
Hey buds, a hotfix has arrived!

Thanks to everyone who’s left us feedback and flagged bugs over the last 24 hours. Our devs have been hard at work, optimising and fixing - and we’ve been able to push a patch today to address many of your reports.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/97fc6e53b55386a30effb8dd9e8858bfae7e5823.png

💩 Help, I’ve run out of fertiliser!
We’ve seen a few softlock moments during our tutorial, where the player hasn’t been able to progress as they’ve used up their fertiliser and struggles to find more. We’ve doubled the amount of smoosh and ooze in Baggle’s inventory so you can easily purchase more to complete the quest.

You can also get smoosh by leaving crops on the ground to decay, and ooze spawns around Ruffians at night. Hopefully you won’t run out now!

💩 Help, the floor ate my items!
We’ve seen reports that players have found themselves stuck in the ground, and in some cases, the ground has stolen all their items. When this happens, the game will try to force respawn your Bud if you’re unable to get free - and this will automatically revert you to a previous save state.

So, if you didn’t have anything in your inventory at that time, you’ll have an empty inventory when you’ve respawned. We recommend two things…

[olist]
 If you get stuck, try to ragdoll your way free, before the game tries to force respawn your Bud.
 Manually save regularly, so that if this does happen, it won’t be quite as devastating if some (hopefully less) of your items have gone missing.
[/olist]
To save your game, press “Start”, navigate to the ⚙️ tab at the top, and press “Save Game”.

💩 Help, I need player support!
If you need to get in touch with us to report a bug not currently on our Known Issues thread, or mentioned in the fixes below, you can visit support.southfieldgame.com to raise a ticket. We also have a dedicated bug reporting forum in our community Discord.

Please be mindful that we are a small team and may not be able to respond to every report, but we’ll keep you posted on any fixes.

🌱 Full patch notes

 Added Smoosh and Ooze into Baggle’s inventory
 Moved Smoosh to be an immediate reward before the fertiliser quest
 Adjusted the time it takes for crops to grow
 Reduced growth time for Boinger crops
 Boinger crops now provide more stamina when eaten
 Fixed issue where players were not able to reset themselves
 Adjusted LOD (level of detail) distances to alleviate popping issues
 Changes to music near Vex for less ear ache
 Items should no longer be instantly picked up again when dropped
 Increased Seedbag production time
 Campfires are now lit for increased vibes
 Ruffians will now disappear when you clear the Vex corruption zone
 Fix for the soil tiles not switching type based on terrain
 Some fixes to collision issues
 Various UI fixes

notes.title: Important Update on Multiplayer in Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey, Buds!

We've got an important update from the Southfield team...

Our game has grown so much since the Next Fest demo back in February. We’re excited to show you all the hard work our devs have put into Southfield, with a fresh new Island, more crops, quests, construction options, and customisations.

You’ll soon be able to jump in and start building your own farmstead, meet the locals, and explore the unpredictable Island of Southfield. You’ll discover and grow your own chaotic crops, and invent new ways to automate your harvest.

What's happening with Multiplayer?

Growing this game has been a labour of love. And while we’re proud of our journey so far, we know there’s further to go - and we’re grateful to our community for coming along with us.

Southfield was originally conceived as a single-player experience, but as soon as we started playtesting the game, people told us that they would love to share this island with friends. We agree, and that’s why multiplayer has been a part of our roadmap for a while!

However, multiplayer engineering is one of the most complex things to pull off for a relatively small development team, meaning we’ve had to make some pretty tough decisions and one of those is to not include multiplayer at Early Access launch.

Southfield is a game with many moving parts, which are made more complicated by our physics systems. This means that, right now, it’s a real challenge to make multiplayer work and be a fun experience to share with your friends. 

We’re committed to keeping you informed on our progress towards bringing multiplayer to Southfield, and when we have an update, we’ll let you all know via Discord, social media or our Steam community hub.

What's going to be changing right now?

Our original Steam store page mentioned multiplayer, and our art for the game also featured multiple Buds. We realise this could be misleading, so we will be removing the additional Buds and mentions of Multiplayer for now.

Southfield Early Access Plans

Our Early Access schedule has changed, with Southfield now aiming to leave Early Access sometime in 2025. Making games is difficult and stressful, but with this extended release plan, the team has more space and time to make Southfield an even richer and evolving single-player experience, and a genuinely fun-filled multiplayer game too!

We have brought some features forward to our Early Access launch to make sure that your first adventure into Southfield is even more jam-packed with ways to play and create, a few of these being:

🌱 The Shovel
A brand new tool used to gather new resources around the island… oh and you can surf on it, too!

🌱 Multi-resource Construction
Use the editing mode to take your constructive creations to the next level, with loads more building materials (e.g. glass, brick, etc.)!

🌱 Bombs, Bombs, Bombs
We have added many more bomb variations so you can discover all manner of explosive gameplay.

We're focused on making Southfield the best single-player experience we can for launch. We want to make this a place you will want to spend hours in, curating, cultivating and making your home! We want you to be free to explore and create, to meet the Islanders and discover their secrets and quirks.

And we want to know what you think, how you play, and what you love. We want you to come on this journey with us, through Early Access and full release. During that time, we hope to learn a lot, which will help us make sure that when we do launch multiplayer, it will be about sharing all the things you already love, and delivering new ways to play together!

More news to follow soon! And as always, thank you so much for your support.

Stay wibbly,
Flop and the Southfield team! 💙

notes.title: Community Update | Demo VS Now
notes.notes:
🎬 New dev update video!

In this quick community update, we take a sneak peek at the new Island, from concept art to in-game landscaping and detailing, and we discuss how your feedback from our Next Fest demo has been implemented.

The Island of Southfield has changed a lot since our demo. A quick glance at the horizon and you’ll see new things… just everywhere! From mushrooms that glow in the dark, to waterfalls and winding rivers dividing the Island, Southfield feels entirely new (because it is).

[previewyoutube=D2nNREfFXf0;full][/previewyoutube]

Video Highlights
🌱  Upgraded Island (featuring ARCHES)
🌱  Windmills, waterfalls and rivers
🌱  The mushrooms GLOW IN THE DARK
🌱  Reveal: Crop Combiner (new machine)
🌱  Bud can eat crops now (but should they?)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/c78688bb945a4e80a9e7eabd50bdd62b90c0c1ca.gif

📝 Player Feedback

Thanks to everyone who left us feedback when playing during our Next Fest demo period. All your comments were reviewed by our team, and we've been able to make changes and improvements based on your shared experiences.

👉 Camera movement sensitivity and motion sickness
The FPS drops and erratic camera movement definitely did not help things when it comes to motion sickness, but we’ve made improvements to the camera movement, and our options menu so you’ll have much more control over your experience. We’ve also improved our vehicles, with a directionally tied camera to reduce that floaty feeling when driving, and hopefully reducing triggers for motion sickness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/09cb75bd64c399051cc229f09511f1696821ee5c.gif

👉 Respawning vehicles on the go
It kinda sucks when you get your ride stuck on some particularly pointy rocks, or you happen to drive into a lake. We’ve now made the vehicle spawn platform portable, so you can respawn your ride wherever you are. All you have to do is hit it with an axe, and put it in your pocket.

👉 UI improvements to machines
We’re continuously working to improve our UI, and this has recently looked like improved communication for how to use machines (which proved an issue for some demo players). We’ve also made ALL machines interactable by either approaching and pressing a button, or the tried and trusted “lob it in” method.

👉 UI prompt to find Almanac
Players were also struggling to find the Almanac in our demo. We’ve now added a UI prompt so that every time you find a new crop, you’ll be able to jump straight to the Almanac and track your discovery.

👉 Control NPC volume
Players wanted to control NPC dialogue volume. We’ve added this so you can tweak it to your liking, and we’re continuing to look at ways to improve chatting with NPCs based on your feedback.

👉 Better balance to soundtrack
Players commented on the odd silences where there was just no music playing in the demo. We go deeper into our goals for the Southfield soundtrack in our dev update video. While the game will have more tracks and ambient sounds than the demo did, we still appreciate silent moments can be a problem for streamers who are relying on our music (and while this won't necessarily be added in Early Access, we're happy to add a setting so you can control the frequency in which music is played)!

✨ Axolotl Outfit Reveal ✨
We reveal our little pink Axolotl onesie in the dev update, but we've also been working to ensure a lot of our skins have plenty of colour variants to choose from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/fa83a504d5c21f367243b263eb044afb06785460.png

📢 Community Shoutouts

Our very own Rhaps (a VIB and valued Discord moderator) kindly created this adorable emoji and sticker for our community, in celebration of the axolotl outfit reveal. Why not pop by our server and do a little flap?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/af2158f8e54ae15e2a4a1578ce3a7e8ac9982b84.gif

That's all for now!

Stay wibbly,
Flop 💙

notes.title: Southfield | Hotfix | Demo Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
Big news, buds!

Flop here, I come bearing some good news! We've pushed a hotfix, in the hopes we can reduce some of the performance issues players of our demo have been reporting... and just in time for the weekend!

I wanted to give you a quick run down of what we've been working on. We are limited to what we can do right now, and optimisation takes time. Still, we're confident this will help people experiencing crashes on launch, and generally make the demo experience a bit smoother.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/ac5836f3e512890aec06b6ba8e7c51822ac6cef1.png

⭐ Lag at launch/crash
Players have reported a lot of lag when launching the demo. Provided you are playing above the minimum spec, this should be fixed! If you're closer to minimum spec. than recommended, we'd still suggest giving the demo a minute to warm up.

⭐ Day/Night transition lag
The lag reported when transitioning from day to night should be minimised, while the lag transitioning from night to day should be fixed. The lag players have been experiencing between 9pm and 6am in-game has been improved but is still apparent.

⭐ Additional changes
We've made some adjustments to the tutorial as some players were getting confused about the quest to fix up the house for Grumps. It should be a bit more obvious now what to do! We've also added a stone cutter outside the farm for flips and giggles.

We just want to thank everyone who's taken the time to leave feedback. You've been patient with us, and that's not gone unnoticed. We all really appreciate your support, the constructive criticism, the bug reports - and the recognition that this is a demo. It's a work in progress, and just a flavour of what Southfield is going to become.

Thank you for that.

Stay wibbly,
Flop 💙
